{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Son, a lord wouldn't know a ''flarg'' from a blue-tailed ''flangth''-hound.|A disgraced [[House Guard]]|<ref name="PGT">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref>}}
The '''blue-tailed flangth-hound''' was a creature. One disgraced former [[House Guard]]sman held the opinion that a [[Lord/Legends|lord]] did not know the difference between the creature and [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#F|flarg]], meaning it was the Guard's responsibility to save the [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] from themselves.<ref name="PGT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blue-tailed flangth-hound was mentioned in the character template for the Disgraced House Guardsman in ''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''. The relationship between the creature and the popular food [[flangth]] was not elaborated on.
